name: Skill install
responsibility: Registers the run's checkout through the CLI, then lays the arm's package, the frozen baseline or the candidate copy the batch kept, in the run's agents' skills root
description: TASK-601. The run registers its checkout with repo add, as archboard init does, and lays the package itself, so a run needs no skills CLI and no network. The run's vault is the .archboard/vault that the run's checkout already holds (the run's configuration is written there before the install), so a command run in the checkout finds it without a setting. The install record holds the digest of the installed skill.
